entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕词头 Sobornio 疑即 soborno（贿赂）或 soberbio（骄矜）之旧写；西文定义两处残缺（subibis、ediora），汉字串「最假色确」义未明
entries.en: [entry largely damaged, gloss uncertain] Sobornio: probably bribery (soborno) or arrogance (soberbio), 17th-c. spelling
entries.notes: L 栏 subibis、ediora 两处[残]，四栏无法互证，仅词头可辨，不敢定夺。

entries.zh: 强嘴；强辩顶撞、嘴硬多言
entries.en: a glib, overbearing mouth; to talk back and argue defiantly

entries.zh: 贿；以财物收买人、行贿
entries.en: to bribe, corrupt with money; bribe money (cohecho)

entries.zh: 赂；行贿、用以买通的财物
entries.en: to bribe; a bribe or gift used to corrupt (cohecho)

entries.zh: 贿赂；以财货买通人
entries.en: bribery; to bribe with money or gifts

entries.zh: 买嘱；买通嘱托、花钱使人代办其事
entries.en: to buy someone over and entrust a task; to bribe (comprar)
entries.notes: M 栏首字音号 T99 污损、西文第二词有异读之疑，故降低置信；释义据 H「买嘱」与 L comprar。

entries.zh: 抹舌；巧舌抹饰、甜言谄媚以笼络人
entries.en: to smooth over with the tongue; to flatter with sweet words
entries.notes: 第二字「舌」与「𠯑」未能定夺，「谄媚」系据 sobornar 旧义（以言辞腐蚀人）推断。

entries.zh: 塞口；堵嘴封口（以财货使人缄默）
entries.en: to stop the mouth; to gag and silence someone with money

entries.zh: 贿赂书吏；「过带」二字义未明〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to bribe the scribe/notary (escribano)
entries.notes: L 栏「贿赂书吏」完整可据；H「过带」、M「âr soa[残]」义未安，汉字释义存疑。

entries.zh: 贿赂先生（代书识字人）；「过先生」取义未安〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to bribe the lettered scribe (sin-sē)
entries.notes: 马尼拉语境「先生」多指识字代书者；M 栏[残]，「过」字义未明。

entries.zh: 补搭；缝补修补、弥补欠缺（花钱打点以补救其事）
entries.en: to patch and mend; to make up for or remedy by paying off
entries.notes: 西文宾语 playa/playo 未能定夺（疑为讹字），「补搭」按打点弥补取义。

entries.zh: 分班；分组分派、摊派工班份额
entries.en: to divide into groups or shifts; to apportion shares

entries.zh: 剩；剩余、多出
entries.en: to be left over, remain in surplus

entries.zh: 残；残余剩余之物
entries.en: leftover, remnant; what remains

entries.zh: 残剩；残余与剩余
entries.en: remnants and surplus; leftovers

entries.zh: 立不了；屋中站立安放用不尽、尚有余地
entries.en: to have room to spare in the house; space left over

entries.zh: 食不了；吃不完、饭菜有余剩下
entries.en: to have food left over; more food than can be eaten
entries.notes: M 栏尾部夹注 comida sobran…la sobra[残] 拼读杂糅；主干「食袂了＝吃不完」与西文相合，故仍出释义。

entries.zh: 剩无几；所剩不多、剩下没有多少
entries.en: to have little left over; scarcely anything remains
entries.notes: M 栏尾三音节（yoro idoa）连写难辨并伴 T99 污损，疑为西语夹注残文。

entries.zh: 衰微；衰落凋零、渐趋败落（所余无几）
entries.en: to decline and wane; dwindled to little
entries.notes: M 栏首字涂改、音号 T99；「衰微」与 sobrar poco 之「衰减所余无几」义相配。

entries.zh: 剩几；剩余若干（若「幾」为闽语「濟」（多）之形讹，则义为剩余很多）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: much remains / some remains (sobrar mucho; Chinese gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: H「剩幾」与 L mucho 不谐，M「xoā」音近闽语「濟」（多），疑形讹；M 栏另有涂改残文。
